newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent fall cushioned on concerns over Iraq.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent fall cushioned on concerns over Iraq.

text.p: The fall in Brent futures prices in Asia were cushioned in late trading on Wednesday amid market concerns over a report that the United States was contemplating a missile strike aginst Iraq, brokers said.
They said the market remained jittery despite the United Nations dismissing the German newspaper report and the US saying it has "no heightened concern" over the situation in Iraq.
But the UN admitted that they continue to have significant problems in all areas and that Iraq may have an operational missile force.
